extension.summary: View your Immich photos and videos in Kodi
extension.description: Browse the timeline and albums of a self-hosted Immich server and watch them as a slideshow with slow pan and zoom. View only: nothing is changed on the server.
extension.disclaimer: Requires an Immich server that you own or have an account on. Not affiliated with the Immich project.
extension.news: v0.1.0: initial release - sign in, timeline, albums and slideshow
